title: Puzzle 3D Catalogue Drag and Drop Restore
description: Restore Puzzle 3D catalogue→viewport drag-and-drop with live mesh preview, grid-snapped placement, and dual HTML5/pointer transport on World3dHost + catalogue MIME stack.
summary:
Restored Puzzle 3D catalogue→viewport drag-and-drop on the post-migration stack.

- World3dHost: HTML5 + pointer-palette drop bridge, grid-snapped ground raycast, live CatalogueDropGhost preview, commit via addObjectKind with origin

Manual: drag kind from catalogue onto 3D viewport — ghost follows cursor, drop places and selects object.
